capabilities: Convert selected text into a slash-style binary tree drawing
Insert trees via an input dialog with live preview
Render ```tree code blocks as trees in Reading view and Live Preview
Auto-detect four input formats (levels, parent lines, LeetCode arrays, indented lists)
Configure subtree gaps, null tokens, array interpretation, and fence tags
disambiguation: Not a file-tree or outliner plugin; it renders binary-tree diagrams as ASCII art from structured text input.
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin browser; installable via BRAT or manually from releases. UI is localized in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sketch binary trees from structured text, so algorithm notes require drawing trees by hand or in an external tool.
summary: Text-to-diagram converter that turns parent-child lines, LeetCode arrays, or indented lists into slash-style (/ \) binary tree drawings for algorithm notes.
